contentSections.title: The Irrevocable End of the WordPress Era in Enterprise B2B
contentSections.content: Many established Hessian companies still rely—against better judgment—on monolithic content management systems like WordPress. Yet the demands on modern, mission-critical B2B websites have changed dramatically in recent years. WordPress was conceived over two decades ago as a pure blogging platform. Its use in enterprise environments inevitably leads to structural problems: a bloated code foundation, constant security vulnerabilities from insecure third-party plugins, and sluggish database queries that drag load times into the ground. As a specialized Next.js agency, we liberate your company from these technological legacies. We build on a modern, decoupled headless architecture. This means for you: absolute design freedom without theme restrictions, elimination of unexpected plugin conflicts, a drastically reduced attack surface for cybercrime, and frontend performance that leaves your competitors far behind. Anyone looking to dominate the B2B market today can no longer afford WordPress compromises.

contentSections.title: Next.js Edge Technology: An Unfair Competitive Advantage for Hessian Export Champions
contentSections.content: Next.js, combined with React and cutting-edge edge computing via platforms like Vercel, is the architectural foundation of the world's most successful and highest-traffic digital platforms. For you as a manufacturing company, service provider, or technology corporation in Hessen, this means specifically: your website no longer loads in seconds, but in milliseconds. This speed advantage has profound psychological and economic implications. Studies show that B2B decision-makers are extremely sensitive to slow websites—bounce rates rise exponentially, and trust in your technological competence plummets. Through advanced Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR), Next.js delivers your content pre-rendered and lightning-fast. Google and other search engines can index your content rapidly and efficiently. This secures you a decisive visibility advantage in the fiercely contested global B2B market. Coday brings exactly this uncompromising enterprise technology directly to you in Hessen.

contentSections.title: High-End UI/UX Design: Trust as the Strongest Currency in B2B Sales
contentSections.content: In high-ticket B2B business—whether complex industrial systems, financial services, or IT infrastructure—your website is almost always the first, most critical touchpoint with potential enterprise clients, investors, or top-tier talent. An average, template-based design sends a fatal message: anyone who cuts corners on their own digital presence presumably also compromises on product quality. At Coday, we don't view web design as superficial decoration or simply filling text into prefabricated grids. We create digital bespoke suits that radiate authority and technological leadership. Our design process combines minimalist, clean aesthetics, generous white space, precise typographic hierarchies, and subtle, hardware-accelerated micro-animations. We translate your complex B2B identity into a visual language that builds trust and eliminates cognitive friction. Your digital presence will appear just as professional, innovative, and reliable as the services and products your company is known for in Hessen.

contentSections.title: Enterprise-Grade Security Architecture: Protection Against Reputational Damage and Data Theft
contentSections.content: Cybersecurity for the Hessian Mittelstand—and especially for companies in the financial metropolis of Frankfurt—has long ceased to be merely an IT task; it's a core management concern. Conventional CMS platforms are a constant target for automated cyberattacks due to their widespread use and monolithic structure. A compromised web presence leads to massive reputational damage and potentially severe GDPR penalties. Coday's headless approach with Next.js drastically reduces this risk. Since the frontend (the visual website) is completely separated from the backend (database and CMS), there is simply no direct connection for attackers to exploit. We completely forgo insecure plugins and implement strict Content Security Policies (CSP), secure session management via Supabase, and cutting-edge authentication methods. Your B2B platform becomes a digital fortress that signals maximum security to your clients and partners.

contentSections.title: API-First and Seamless System Integration for Digital Transformation
contentSections.content: Hessian industrial companies are in the midst of digital transformation. The website can no longer be an isolated marketing silo—it must function as a central hub for data and business processes. Monolithic systems often fail miserably at connecting modern microservices or require expensive, unstable bridge solutions. Our Next.js platforms are built API-first from the ground up. Whether you need to retrieve complex product data from a PIM system, connect your Salesforce or HubSpot CRM for seamless lead tracking, or integrate internal ERP interfaces—we deliver seamless data flows. This architectural openness ensures that your website can respond flexibly to new digital demands and business models not just today, but for the next decade.

contentSections.title: Sanity CMS: The Revolution in Editorial Workflows
contentSections.content: A cutting-edge website is only as agile as the team maintaining it. We consciously chose against legacy systems and in favor of Sanity—the most advanced headless CMS on the market. For your marketing department in Hessen, this represents a paradigm shift. No more cluttered dashboards, no more fear that a careless change might break the entire page layout. We develop a custom, streamlined editorial interface where your teams manage content in genuine data structures rather than rigid page templates. Sanity enables real-time collaboration similar to Google Docs and strictly separates content from design. This allows your content to be reused not only on your website, but in the future also across apps, digital signage, or customer portals—true cross-channel publishing.

contentSections.title: Scalability and Maximum ROI for Long-Term Growth
contentSections.content: An investment in a custom Next.js platform from Coday is a strategic decision for the future direction of your company. The Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of a monolithic website is often underestimated: hidden costs for constant security updates, server maintenance, performance optimizations, and expensive relaunches every three years consume your budgets. Our headless solutions are designed for longevity. The frontend can be iteratively evolved without needing to replace the backend or CMS. Superior performance leads to demonstrably higher conversion rates and better SEO rankings, continuously reducing your cost per acquisition (CPA). We don't build throwaway websites—we build digital assets that measurably contribute to the enterprise value of your Hessian brand and deliver unprecedented return on investment.

faq.q: Why should we, as a Hessian industrial company, switch from WordPress to Next.js?
faq.a: Switching from WordPress to a Next.js headless architecture offers you three business-critical advantages that determine success and failure in the B2B sector: uncompromising security, superior performance, and unlimited scalability. WordPress, originally conceived as blogging software, carries enormous historical baggage. It requires constant plugin updates to patch security vulnerabilities and links frontend and database in an insecure manner. Next.js separates these layers (headless). This makes cyberattacks extremely unattractive and difficult. At the same time, Next.js pages load in milliseconds through server-side rendering and edge delivery, perfecting Core Web Vitals and significantly boosting your visibility on Google.

faq.q: How does the performance of a Next.js site concretely impact our B2B lead generation?
faq.a: Performance in the B2B space is not a technical gimmick—it's a hard conversion factor. Studies demonstrate that a one-second delay in load time can cause conversion rates to drop by up to 20%. High-caliber decision-makers have little time; a slow website signals a lack of technological competence. Next.js delivers extremely fast LCP values (Largest Contentful Paint), often under 1.5 seconds. This fluid, app-like user experience (through client-side navigation after initial load) eliminates cognitive friction, keeps users on the page, and dramatically increases the likelihood of a qualified contact inquiry.

faq.q: We have hundreds of technical articles and case studies. Do you offer seamless data migration?
faq.a: Absolutely. As a premium agency, we leave nothing to chance during relaunches. We first design the optimal data structure in our modern headless CMS (Sanity v3). Then we migrate your existing content—from blog posts and case studies to complex product databases—in an automated, structured process from your legacy system (e.g., WordPress, TYPO3). Through clean 301 redirect mapping, we ensure that your hard-earned SEO rankings and backlinks are fully preserved.

faq.q: Isn't a headless CMS much more complicated for our marketing team to use than WordPress?
faq.a: Quite the opposite. WordPress's supposed simplicity is often undermined by bloated page builders (like Elementor), hundreds of menu items, and plugin conflicts. We use Sanity CMS and configure the interface precisely to your editorial needs. Your marketing team in Hessen sees only what they need to see. The input forms are intuitive, modern, and strictly separate content from design (Structured Content). Your team can focus on writing, while the system ensures that the high-end website design can never be 'broken' under any circumstances.

faq.q: Our IT places great emphasis on data security. How secure is the architecture you develop?
faq.a: Security is the core of our development philosophy. Monolithic systems present hackers with an easy target since database, CMS, and frontend all reside on the same server. Our Jamstack/headless architecture completely decouples these layers. The Next.js frontend communicates only through highly secured APIs with the backend. We forgo error-prone third-party plugins, implement strict Content Security Policies (CSP) via Next.js Middleware, and utilize enterprise-grade auth solutions like Supabase. Even if an attack on the frontend were to occur, your business-critical database remains completely isolated.

faq.q: How do the ongoing maintenance costs of Next.js compare to WordPress?
faq.a: WordPress is notorious for its hidden maintenance costs (TCO – Total Cost of Ownership). Regular core updates, plugin updates, resolving compatibility issues, and database maintenance consume significant budget. A Next.js architecture is considerably more maintenance-efficient. Since there are no plugins in the traditional sense and hosting scales fully automatically via serverless platforms (like Vercel), classic server maintenance tasks are virtually eliminated. You no longer invest your budget in maintaining outdated technology but in the active, strategic evolution of your platform.

faq.q: Can you integrate our existing CRM (e.g., Salesforce) and ERP into the new website?
faq.a: Yes. This is one of the greatest advantages of our API-first strategy. Unlike closed systems that rely on error-prone bridge plugins, Next.js is purpose-built to communicate with any REST or GraphQL APIs. We can push form submissions directly and securely into Salesforce or HubSpot, retrieve product data in real-time from your ERP system, or connect secure B2B customer portals. Your website thus functions as a high-performance dashboard and intelligent connector for your entire digital value chain.

faq.q: How long does it take to develop a high-end B2B corporate website at Coday?
faq.a: Enterprise-level quality demands precision. We don't work with pre-built themes—we develop every platform from scratch, from in-depth brand analysis through custom UI/UX design to uncompromising technical implementation. For a comprehensive B2B project including headless CMS integration, complex data structures, and SEO migration, we typically plan for a timeline of 8 to 14 weeks. Every project undergoes our most rigorous quality controls (performance, accessibility, security) before go-live.

faq.q: Do you work exclusively for companies in Hessen, or also across other regions?
faq.a: As a Hessian agency (headquartered in Wetzlar), we know and value the local economic landscape—from Frankfurt's financial district to the hidden champions in Northern and Central Hessen. However, we are digitally and technologically positioned globally. We serve demanding B2B clients throughout Germany, the DACH region, and beyond. Digital collaboration tools enable smooth, efficient teamwork regardless of where your headquarters are located. For strategic kickoffs and key milestones, we are of course happy to meet in person on-site.

faq.q: Do you consider accessibility requirements during development?
faq.a: Accessibility is not an afterthought for us—it's an integral part of our development process. In accordance with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) and with regard to upcoming accessibility legislation (such as the European Accessibility Act), we ensure that our Next.js platforms are accessible to all users. This includes proper semantic HTML structures, ARIA labels for screen readers, perfect color contrasts, and full keyboard navigability. High accessibility also improves usability for all users and sends extremely positive signals to the Google algorithm.

faq.q: What happens to our website during major traffic spikes, such as after a large PR campaign?
faq.a: Traditional servers (e.g., from typical WordPress hosts) quickly reach their limits during sudden visitor surges—the site becomes slow or crashes completely (downtime). We host our Next.js platforms on modern edge networks like Vercel. This serverless architecture scales fully automatically and in milliseconds. Your website isn't served from a single server in Frankfurt but is distributed globally across nodes around the world. Even the most massive traffic spikes are effortlessly absorbed without you needing to manually add server capacity.

faq.q: Do you use standardized templates, or is the design completely custom?
faq.a: Coday stands for uncompromising custom design. We reject the generic 'template look' that is unfortunately still ubiquitous in the B2B world. Every design element, every micro-animation, and the entire layout concept is individually developed for your brand to visually reinforce your strategic positioning. We use TailwindCSS 4 to translate this design pixel-for-pixel into high-performance code. The result is a digital identity that is 100% unique and unmistakably sets you apart from your competitors.

faq.q: How does Coday ensure the website remains successful long-term after launch?
faq.a: A relaunch is not the end for us—it's the beginning of a successful digital growth phase. Although ongoing maintenance efforts (as with WordPress) are eliminated, we don't leave you on your own. We offer strategic consulting, continuous performance monitoring, technical audits, and iterative platform evolution. Through the flexible Next.js and headless structures, we can implement new landing pages, features, or integrations agilely and rapidly while your day-to-day operations continue undisturbed.

faq.q: We're a highly specialized mechanical engineering company. Do you even understand our industry?
faq.a: The Hessian mechanical and plant engineering sector, as well as precision mechanics, is characterized by the highest complexity. As a B2B-focused agency, our strength lies not in building machines, but in staging complex technical subjects with digital excellence. We dive deep into your subject matter, analyze your target audience (engineers, procurement managers, C-level executives), and develop the information architecture and design so that your highly specialized products become digitally tangible and experientially showcasing their full innovative power.

faq.q: What does a custom Next.js corporate website from Coday cost?
faq.a: Since we don't offer template systems but develop highly specialized digital enterprise products, costs depend heavily on project complexity. Influencing factors include the number of individual page types (templates in the CMS), the depth of CMS modeling, migration of existing content, multilingual support (internationalization), and integration of third-party systems (APIs). We work with transparent budgeting based on clearly defined milestones. In a no-obligation initial consultation, we analyze your requirements and provide you with a reliable and transparent investment estimate.
